subject: website
name: Impersonator
summary: Impersonator, a developer tool to use dapps as any address. Its source is public (MIT). It is not Level 3: when it opens it loads Google Tag Manager from another host and WalletConnect's hidden verify frame, third-party code the user has not asked for. It also reads from public RPC endpoints.

connections.name: Google Tag Manager and Analytics
connections.note: Script from googletagmanager.com loaded when the page opens, with calls to google-analytics.com.

connections.name: WalletConnect verify frame and servers
connections.note: Frame from verify.walletconnect.com, plus the relay socket and wallet list, loaded before any wallet is connected.
